description: Update an existing test case in BrowserStack Test Management. Any subset of the following fields may be changed: name, description, preconditions, test_case_steps, owner, priority, case_type, automation_status, status, tags, issues, custom_fields. Only the supplied fields are modified. Requires a project identifier (PR-*). No tool here lists projects, so if you do not have one, call askBrowserStackAI with product "tm" and ask which projects exist, then retry this tool with the identifier it returns.

automation_status.description: Updated automation status. Use internal name such as 'not_automated', 'automated', 'automation_not_required', 'cannot_be_automated', or 'obsolete'.

case_type.description: Updated test case type. Accepts either display name (e.g. 'Functional', 'Regression', 'Smoke & Sanity') or internal name (e.g. 'functional', 'smoke_sanity'). Valid values are per-project.

custom_fields.description: Map of custom field NAME to value; use an array for multi-select fields.

description.description: Updated brief description of the test case.

issues.description: Replacement list of linked Jira/Asana/Azure issue IDs for the test case.

name.description: Updated name of the test case.

owner.description: Email of the test case owner.

preconditions.description: Updated preconditions for the test case.

priority.description: Updated priority. Accepts either display name (e.g. 'Medium', 'Critical', 'High', 'Low') or internal name (e.g. 'medium'). Valid values are per-project and discoverable via the form-fields endpoint.

project_identifier.description: The ID of the BrowserStack project containing the test case to update.

status.description: Updated review status of the test case (e.g. 'active', 'draft', 'in_review', 'outdated', 'rejected').

tags.description: Replacement list of tags for the test case.

test_case_identifier.description: The ID of the test case to update. This can be found using the listTestCases tool.

test_case_steps.description: Updated list of test case steps with expected results.

result.description: The expected result of this step.

step.description: The action to perform in this step.

name: updateTestCase
